newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to turn Housing Bank into commercial bank.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to turn Housing Bank into commercial bank.

text.p: South Korea plans to draft a bill within the first half to turn the state-funded Housing and Commercial Bank into a commercial bank, the finance ministry said on Wednesday.
The new bill would replace an existing one that limits the bank to housing purchase-related business, and allow it to engage in more commercial banking activities, a ministry statement said.
But the bank, formerly called the Korea Housing Bank, would continue to handle more housing-related business than other commercial banks do, the statement said.
The move was in line with the ministry's plan announced in 1996 to privatise the bank by the end of 1997, it said.
The government currently holds the largest single stake of 46.8 percent in the bank.
The statement said the government would sell its entire stake in the bank this year but gave no timetable.
